prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
competitors_mentioned: Mr. Handyman of Joplin, Pittsburg & Neosho
Home Builders Association of Southwest Missouri
answer_verbatim:
For **small-to-medium repairs, punch lists, drywall, trim, doors, decks, or light remodeling**, a reasonable first call in the Joplin area is **Mr. Handyman of Joplin, Pittsburg & Neosho**. They are a franchise operation, which can provide more structure for scheduling, insurance, and warranty follow-up than an unverified individual handyman. Still, check their most recent local reviews and get a written scope and price before approving work.

For a **kitchen, bath, addition, major structural repair, or whole-home remodel**, I would not choose from a single recommendation alone. Use the **Home Builders Association of Southwest Missouri** and the **Joplin Area Chamber of Commerce** to identify established local remodelers, then get at least three written bids.

Before hiring any contractor, ask for:

- Proof of **general-liability insurance** and workers’ compensation coverage  
- Three recent, comparable local references—preferably jobs completed in the last year  
- A detailed written contract listing materials, labor, permits, payment schedule, and change-order process  
- Confirmation of who pulls required **City of Joplin permits**  
- Lien waivers from subcontractors/suppliers as payments are made  
- A modest deposit rather than paying most or all of the job upfront  

Avoid anyone who pressures you to sign immediately, only accepts cash, will not provide insurance documentation, or offers a price dramatically below the other bids.

If you share the type of project—such as bathroom remodel, roof leak, foundation issue, electrical repair, deck, etc.—I can help narrow down what kind of contractor to look for and what a good bid should include.
